correctness.rationale: Verified the finite ordered diametral vertex set and strict-positive cone heights, forcing uniform O(t) localization. In cone variables the radial deficit is s-t||Pi_e(Z-Y)||²/(2D)+O(t²); radial integration over the 2d-cone gives the beta leading coefficient (d!)²/(2d)!. Heights have Dirichlet(d,d,1) law and uniform transverse sections, yielding T_ab=[d(d+1)(Ma+Mb)-2d² mu_a·mu_b]/[2D(2d+1)] as a positive mean-square coefficient. For orthotopes, section moments simplify to (3D²ΣLi^-2-d(2d+1))/(D(2d+1)); Cauchy–Schwarz gives equality only for equal lengths. Independently verified 135 exact rational box specializations for dimensions 3..7 and all small length patterns; special cases do not replace general analytic localization.
